'''Elam Mattic''' was an individual from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] who moved to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].

==Biography==
Elam Mattic was brought up on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where their family owned a pet of an unspecified species that they named [[Hyperdrive (pet)|Hyperdrive]].

Elam's uncle, [[Louie Mattic]], gave them a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and taught them how to use it. When Elam planned to move to [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], Louie hoped that his blaster instruction would protect his relative from the [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] violence that plagued the planet.

By [[3956 BBY]], Elam had migrated to Taris. Erstwhile, their brother left for [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to become a [[Miner/Legends|miner]], and their pet Hyperdrive followed either one of them. Louie's concern was not misplaced as in that year, Elam's [[Lower City Apartments|apartment]] in the [[Lower City]] was dominated by the presence of [[Black Vulkars/Legends|Black Vulkars]], a gang that killed civilians on the streets indiscriminately as part of their [[Bek–Vulkar gang war|war]] against their rivals, the [[Hidden Beks]].

In light of the severe crime rate, Elam kept their most valuable possessions, including 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], a suit of [[Republic mod armor]], and their uncle's blaster pistol secured in a [[Footlocker/Legends|strongbox]]. This safe was locked by a computerized touch panel that employed a password entry system, and it was impossible for Tarisians to slice into due to it being a foreign and by 3956 BBY, outdated, model. In spite of this, Elam added an additional layer of security in the form of a [[Gas mine|minor gas mine]].

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Nevertheless, the strongbox was cracked by the mind-wiped former [[Jedi]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and his companions when they wandered into Elam's apartment during the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire's]] occupation of Taris. Louie had left an electronic message on Elam's personal message center next to the safe, and this message provided all the answers to the box's security questions: the name of Elam's pet (Hyperdrive), the relative that taught Elam to use a blaster (Uncle), and Elam's homeworld (Alderaan). Deactivating the mine, Revan and his friends accessed the crate and retrieved its contents for their own use when Elam was not home.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Elam Mattic only figures as an off-screen non-player character in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''. This individual's [[Species/Legends|species]] and [[Gender/Legends|gender]] is never revealed.

Elam's role in the game is trivial, being only the owner of a strongbox that can be looted by the player, Revan, and doing so has no effect on the storyline nor does it serve as a quest.

As is the case with many role-playing video games, robbing Elam's room doesn't affect the player's alignment.
